summary: Improve executive scheduling, decision tracking and records control with practical office-support tools. Explore the course and plan your next step.
lede: Executive office management helps executive assistants, office coordinators and support supervisors coordinate priorities and keep decisions moving. The work includes triaging requests with the Eisenhower Matrix, controlling calendar changes, and maintaining decision and action logs with clear ownership and follow-up. Learners also practise handling sensitive records, drafting executive correspondence and reporting service measures in an Excel dashboard.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who coordinate executive work, manage confidential information or keep leadership decisions moving across teams.
modules: Outlook Time Allocation and Schedule Resilience
prerequisites: Prior experience in executive, administrative or office support is expected, along with routine use of business email and calendars. No coding or programming is required.
